question: Two students measure the electric field at the same point in vacuum. Student X uses a test charge q₀ and measures force F. Student Y repeats the measurement with 2q₀ at the same point and finds the force is 2F. State the correct conclusion about the electric field magnitude E at that point.

options.A: E is the same in both trials; E = F/q₀ = (2F)/(2q₀). The larger test charge only doubles the force, not the field.
options.B: E doubles because a larger test charge samples more field lines.
options.C: E halves because the ratio F/q increases when q increases.
options.D: E is undefined for 2q₀ unless the charge is negative.
